title: Spotify saved-tracks paging on Music Songs is verified live on a connected account
acceptance: On a Spotify account the Web API serves (not 403), Music › Spotify › Songs shows a "Load more" after the first 200 saved tracks and loads the next ones in saved order.
Search on Spotify Songs finds a saved track past the first page by loading more pages, and says when it stopped at the 1,000-song bound.
"Create class from liked songs" on Spotify says when it used a subset of the saved tracks.
nextAction: Waits for RF-92 (Spotify Web API returns 403 for the connected account). RF-132 shipped Spotify saved-tracks paging mock-tested only (offset cursor, X-RitmoFit-Next-Cursor header on GET /providers/spotify/likes). Once RF-92 is Done, verify the acceptance in a real browser on production; fix in packages/music/src/spotify.ts if the live shape differs. Owner-gated (provider code) if a fix is needed. Agent-created: Backlog until the owner sets Ready.

evidence.summary: RF-132 owner decision 2026-10-29: close RF-132 on Apple Music and SoundCloud, move the live Spotify check to a Backlog record that depends on RF-92.
